scope: Switzerland medical discovery — University of Lausanne Faculty of Biology and Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: Swissuniversities lists the University of Lausanne among Swiss institutions that determine medical-study eligibility and states that applicants without Swiss nationality or Swiss residence cannot be admitted due to limited places.
Swissuniversities states that Switzerland's medical studies are taught in German and French and that there is no English-taught medical programme.

holdReasons: The global medical-admissions restriction precludes presenting a generally accessible international route.
No current official UNIL Medicine programme, degree structure, fee, language proficiency, programme accreditation, clinical or student-support evidence was established in this review.
UNIL's web domain blocked automated source review, so a gold-standard primary-source packet could not be completed.
nextAction: Only revisit with directly accessible current UNIL official Medicine sources and a full French-language, Swiss-residency-eligibility, fee, accreditation and clinical-support evidence packet.
